Android support

fixed incorrect srgb conversion for wasm

- this happened because by default OpenGL does not do any conversions when writing to a FBO with sRGB color attachment, it only converts sRGB -> Linear when reading. However on OpenGL ES it converts samples in writing to sRGB  and back to linear when reading. This can be changed by GL_FRAMEBUFFER_SRGB, but it is not available on OpenGL ES in most cases. So instead of relying on platform dependent stuff, we convert color from sRGB -> Linear manually when reading
- fix #244
